run_metadata.coverage_summary: Discovery this run was performed via WebSearch only. The environment's network egress policy again blocked direct WebFetch to every tender portal (tenders.gov.au, tenders.nsw.gov.au / buy.nsw.gov.au, tenders.vic.gov.au, tenders.wa.gov.au, tenders.tas.gov.au, tendersonline.nt.gov.au, tenders.act.gov.au, vendorpanel.com.au, tenderlink.com and others all returned EGRESS_BLOCKED), so no tender detail page or specification document could be opened and no deliverables/requirements/documents pass was possible. Tier 1 government portals were swept via search and returned confirmable, recently-published open opportunities for NSW (buy.nsw / eTendering), Victoria (Buying for Victoria), Western Australia (Tenders WA early tender advice), Tasmania (Tenders Tasmania) and the ACT. Tier 2 universities (University of Sydney and University of Adelaide TenderLink portals) yielded current open RFT/EOI rows; GBE/utility procurement (Sydney/Melbourne/SA Water, Transgrid, Western Power, Ausgrid, Snowy Hydro) and council/VendorPanel channels were checked but returned no new confirmable open rows via search this run. Tier 3 corporate was covered via SAP Ariba Discovery (login-gated) and EstimateOne (subscription construction board); no publicly-visible corporate RFx could be read, so corporate portals are recorded in discovered_sources rather than invented as tenders. All captured opportunities are at headline level and flagged for a later authenticated/detail pass.
gaps: EGRESS BLOCKED: WebFetch to all tender portals and e-sourcing platforms was denied by the network egress proxy (verified this run against www.tenders.gov.au -> EGRESS_BLOCKED; the proxy status endpoint confirms selective egress is enforced). No tender detail page, attachment or specification could be opened, so deliverables, key_deliverables, requirements, eligibility, evaluation_criteria, documents, submission mechanics and contacts could not be extracted from source. Every tender below is headline-level from search-result metadata only and needs a detail pass once egress or an authenticated session is available.

Identity/date fields (tender_id, exact closing_time, publish_date) for several search-derived rows are taken from search-result summaries, not confirmed against the tender's own detail page; they still need verification against the portal.

Tasmania rows (Deloraine High School redevelopment consultancy, Rosny Creative Precinct project management) were surfaced with approximate 'posted' dates only and no tender ID or closing date from search; captured at headline level and flagged pending detail. One Tas search snippet referenced a 07-September posting date that is after this run date and was NOT captured, to avoid recording an unverifiable/future item.

South Australia (Tenders SA / Buying4SA), NT (QTOL) and Queensland (QTenders) searches returned no confirmable newly-open rows this run (portal-side date filtering needed; QTenders is mid-migration to VendorPanel via supply.qld.gov.au). Deferred to a future run.

Tier 2 GBE/utilities (Sydney Water, Melbourne Water, SA Water, Transgrid, Powerlink, Western Power, Ausgrid, NBN Co, Australia Post, Snowy Hydro): checked via search but no new publicly-confirmable open opportunity surfaced this run; Western Power Clean Energy Link EOI had already closed 31-Jul-2026 and Transgrid grid-forming battery tender was announced but no open portal row was confirmable. Recorded as sampled-but-no-new-rows.

Tier 3 corporate: SAP Ariba Discovery / SAP Business Network Discovery and buyer Ariba portals (BHP, Coles, Woolworths, Brisbane City) are behind free supplier registration; EstimateOne construction packages are behind a paid/registered subscription. No publicly-visible corporate RFx could be read, so none are recorded as tenders (per the no-fabrication rule).
Invitation-only corporate RFx (e.g. management-consultancy RFPs issued to Accenture/KPMG/Deloitte-type panels) remain out of scope and undiscoverable, as expected.
recommended_seed_additions: Goulburn Valley Water (VIC) - buyer publishing RFTs via Buying for Victoria (e.g. Shepparton WTP disinfection upgrades); regional water corporation worth tracking directly.
Parks Victoria - buyer on Buying for Victoria running significant construction/works procurement (Shrine to Sea).
Victoria Legal Aid - buyer on Buying for Victoria (services procurement, e.g. Employee Assistance Program).
The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne - buyer on Buying for Victoria (health facility fit-out EOIs).
Powerhouse (Museum of Applied Arts and Sciences, MAAS) - buyer on buy.nsw / NSW eTendering; active around the Powerhouse Parramatta opening program.
Unimarket (LGA Procurement, South Australia) - confirm VendorPanel -> Unimarket migration is complete for SA councils and re-point SA local-government checks to Unimarket.
TenderBuilt civil-construction portal guide - AGGREGATOR/discovery signal only (not a buyer source); use to spot new civil buyers, then pivot to the buyer's own portal.
